en: What’re we standing around for? Let’s start breaking shit!

If you think the OSIC are the good guys, bro? You gotta wake up and take a look around. Regulation is just a three-dollar-word for hoarding, which is just a two-dollar-word for controlling, which is just a one-dollar-word for asshole!
The hell are you starin’ at, buddy?
People ask me if I’m angry all the time. And it’s like “yeah, I’m pissed, why aren’t you?”
Hey, your taste in music? Sucks.
Bebop belongs in a scrap pile, and Lash was relevant for like twenty minutes three years ago. I’ll kick both their asses!
Vyper thinks she’s hard because she did time. Lady can’t go three blocks without catchin’ a charge. She’s no con, she’s a moron!
Don’t get me started on Ivy. Savior of Spanish Harlem, psh. You’re a gargoyle that punches people in the face, what do you want, a medal?
You know those people who think havin’ a dog is the same as havin’ a personality? That’s Mirage and the Djinn. I get it, you have a lady in a bottle, stop talking about it!
Jersey? Sucks. But it doesn’t suck as much as Long Island.
You think I wanna hang out with those jackasses? Pass.
I got a riot to start in midtown.
You go complete the ritual, I got some lootin’ to do.
I hope I end up on the other team and I kick your ass.
Don’t pick me, that’s fine! Whatever, I don’t care.
Oh? You got a problem with goats, buddy?
Go pick somebody else, you deserve each other.
If you can’t appreciate what I bring to the table, I don’t wanna help you!
You think it’s “okay” to toy with someone’s feelings like that?
You know what? You didn’t unselect me, I unselected you. Piss off!
You a cop?
No.
You look like a cop.
Why, cause I got a jacket?
You tryna interrogate me, pig?
You're ridiculous.
I got my eye on you.
Knock yourself out.
You ready to tear shit up?
I dunno, you ready to keep up?
Oh, I like your style, big man! This should be fun.
You know how to read that book you're carryin'?
It's a tome.
Ohh, well, look at "Mr. 5 Dollar Word" over here!
So am I a moron who can't read or a snob?
Pick one.
I'm not gonna feel sorry when you get shot.
Slummin' it with the regular people, eh?
Basically.
That was shockingly honest.
Y'know, not gonna lie, I'm surprised you're willing to get your hands dirty... assumed a rich bastard like you would pay for someone else to fight their battles for 'em.
In Ixia, leaders are expected to lead, not delegate.
I can respect that.
Hey, Apollo. I know we don't agree on much, but I just wanted to say that it's bullshit that Ixia hasn't been invited to the Olympics.
That's kind of you to say, Billy.
Right is right, man.
Yes
Hey, Bebop. The old lady that made you-
Shut your mouth, Billy. I'm not in the mood.
Yes
So. You work at a scrapyard.
Live at a scrapyard.
That's kinda cool.
That a compliment?
That's the best you're gonna get, Tin Man.
Yes
Alright, Tin Man. Bring 'em in, and let my bat do the work.
Mate... I've got a bloody laser. What's a bat gonna do?
Shut up!
Hey, buddy. You're lookin' a little rough, you need help findin' a shelter or somethin'?
I'm looking for blood, not your charity.
Alright, cool; go to hell, and I hope you get shot.
You're an old-ass vampire, right?
That's one way to put it.
So: Do you listen to harpsichord, or some other shitty music?
I'm a jazz man.
Okay, some other shitty music. Got it.
Hey Billy, are you a human with a goat head, or a goat with a human body?
Does it matter?
Flavor-wise, absolutely.
Normally, I'd crack someone in the face for sayin' that, but since we're on the same team, I'll respectfully tell you to go to hell.
College is a scam.
It most certainly is not!
Yeah? What do you teach?
Occult metaphysics.
Heh! And what do I do with that degree?
Become an occult metaphysicist.
That's not a real job.
You think you're smarter than me because you teach at Columbia?

Me being smarter than you has nothing to do about where I teach. But to be clear, just because I have progressed more academically, doesn't mean that I have more common sense than you, as evidenced by my current condition.
I'm trying to decide if that's insulting or not.
Billy, I'm saying I'm smarter, not better. But if you want to have a math-off, I'm sure that I can get someone to proctor it.
Nah, we're good.
You look like someone who thinks they're too good to drink wine of out a plastic bag.
I look like someone who can't drink at all.
Shut up, robot.
Not a robot.
I don't care!
So, were you born thinkin' the world owes you? Or did your mommy and daddy have to tell you how special you were.
Way to go, Billy, you've got me all figured out. Truly, you are the master of the human condition.
Don't patronize me!
You look like a pack of cloves with a trust fund.
How much sad poetry do you write?
I bet you got a favorite tombstone to sit on when you have big feelings.
Blackmore Academy? Sucks.
Oh. This, uh... this doesn't work as well when you agree with me.
There's that upper-class ego…
Yes
They got a group of trained killers, and we got a guy with a busted hip and one foot in the grave! This is fair!
I'll be fine.
Basically, this is five on six. The Patron must hate us.
The Patron doesn't hate you. I do.
Yes
I bet the Baxter Society never killed any real monsters. It was all a bunch of smoke and mirrors for publicity.
You don't know what you're talking about.
Big surprise! The mastermind of the whole charade tells me I'm wrong!
You being a moron has nothing to do with me starting the Baxter Society.
Yes
Old timers like you don't know how hard it is in the real world! You're just sitting around, smoking cigars, and getting drunk on nostalgia.
Clearly.
You think being smug makes you better than me?
The fact that I didn't turn my head into a goat makes me better than you.
There it is, there it is! I knew that you were biased against me from the beginning!
You want to act like a jackass, that's your business. But you don't get to be indignant when I point it out. Now shut up, and try not to die.
So how do you wanna do this?
Just cause I gotta work with a pig, doesn't mean I gotta talk to one.
Suit yourself.
You're that goat guy Murphy always talks about, aren't you?
I knew that guy had it out for me...
He really doesn't.
Whatever. Pigs are always coverin' for other pigs.
Alright pig, here's the deal: At some point during the ritual I'm gonna save your life. When that happens, I don't want you thinkin' I actually like you.
Understood.
Good.
Yes
Oh look, if it isn't Carlos Arroyo's talking billboard for his mayoral campaign.
I believe in Carlos.
Yeah, yeah, we all know the stupid story. Lady: he used you to increase the property value of Spanish Harlem, and he's using you to sit in the mayor's mansion!
That's not true.
Whatever you say, stooge.
Yes
Why are you so angry?
I don't need to justify shit to Carlos Arroyo's pet gargoyle.
Yes
Hey, Billy. So, I was wondering...
You ask me how I got the goat head, I'll bash your skull in.
What? People ask about that? That'd be crazy.
So the guy in charge is the only survivor, huh? Typical.
I assure you, I'd give anything to change that, Billy.
Oh yeah? Somethin' tells me you ain't asking the Patron to trade your life for theirs.
So... uh, Billy... how did you get the-
Bro, I'm not gonna be the subject of your next book! So don't bother askin' about the goat head, cause I ain't telling you shit.
Huh, you're being needlessly hostile.
Tell me I'm wrong!
Didn't think so.
You don't look thrilled to be working with me.
Why would I be? You're worse than Seven!
Excuse me? The man's a mass murderer!
Seven killed people that got in his way. You got people killed who believed in you. So yeah, I trust the asshole who knows he's an asshole a lot more than the asshole who doesn't!
Yes
What do I call you?
Not like you actually give a shit, but my name's Billy.
No self-respecting man actually wants to be called "Billy".
Oh, so now you know me.
Believe me, William. I wish I didn't.
Yes
When your ivory tower comes crashing down, I hope you're under it.
Be as snide as you like. At the end of the day, I'll be sleeping in my penthouse, and you'll be chewing on a tin can wondering where your life went wrong.
Oh, I know exactly where my life went wrong, lady.
Impressive. I'm sure you were spoiled for choice.

Alright Mina, here's the deal: On one hand, you're a stuck-up bitch. On the other hand, your goal is to get rid of some old-as-dirt vampire elder. So as much as I hate rich assholes, which you are, I'm gonna help you because there's an older, richer asshole that needs to go.
Lady, I don't wanna be your friend.
Let me guess: Mommy and daddy got you everything.
So what's it like being in the real world where you don't always get what you want?
I don't like-
I ain't takin' the bait, Mina.
Yes
Who are you tryna impress carrying all those books around?
No one! I like to read.
You can't read more than one book at a time.

Well sure, but... you need your breakfast book that gets you going, your coffee book for when you need a little break that you secretly want to be a long break, you got your main book that you're working on, which I'm assuming that's what you meant when you said one book at a time, and then you have your comfort book for when you had a bad day and you just want to disappear on the purple line.
Yes
I get what you're doing.
The hell are you talkin' about?
The whole "mad at the world" schtick. I bet you secretly have the heart of a poet, and are just waiting for the world to be a little kinder.
I hate people.
See, you think you do. But that's just masking some void in your life.
I hate you.
See, that doesn't make any sense, because you don't know me.
I don't wanna know you!
That's what people say in the first act, but then by the third act, they're best friends!
Yes
You know, there's a Shakespeare festival next weekend.
You think I give a shit about some snob that wrote in Middle English?
Well, he didn't write in Middle English, but that's a whole 'nother thing. Point is, everyone loves Midsummer Night's Dream, and you would basically be their king.
Maybe I'll check 'em out.
Yes
So after we win, you gonna let me live on Long Island?
Ehh, it's a tough question; on one hand, you got a goat head. On the other hand, the rest of ya's human, which begs the question: Is 9/10's a human too much human? My guts tellin' me yes.
You really doin' me like that?
Tell ya what: Ya can visit, but ya can't own real estate.
I'll take it.
Yes
Whatcha gonna do to all the humans on Long Island when you take over?
Killin' the shit out of 'em.
Ehh, I know some people there who don't totally suck. If I help you do this, I don't want 'em gettin' hurt.
Give me their names. I'll make sure they're taken care of.
Taken care of, or taken care of?
No- like- actually taken care of, Jesus Billy, come on! I'm not a monster here!
Yes
They're about to find out what happens when you pick a fight with some pissed off New Yorkers!
Oh, it ain't gonna go well for 'em.
Damn right.
You're right to have contempt for humanity.
I'm always right.
Hm, no. You're governed by emotions, not intellect... and as long as you are, others will always see you as a joke.
Being smart didn't save you from the chair.
It didn't... but when they came for me, it was because they feared me. Not because they mocked me.
You ready to dismantle the system?
No.
Bro, you were thrown in an extra-judicial hell hole, and now that you're out you're not gonna stick it to those bastards?!
I "stuck it to them"... when I butchered my captors in Lost Whisper. The government's taken enough from me; they don't get to claim my wish as well.
What are your goals, Billy?
Yeah, to be loud enough to get noticed by people, but not organized enough to end up on a government watchlist.
That's your tactic. What's. your. goal?
You're gonna have to wait to find out like everyone else.
Yes
Billy, you scream of the ills of the world, but do nothing to change them.
Lady, I wake people up, I speak truth to power. What the hell do you do other than walk around Central Park barefoot?!

I'm systematically murdering the bloodline of a judge that used his power to sentence innocent women to death. And in the process, I'm dismantling an extremist neopolitical movement. But do tell me about how important your soapbox is.
The, uh... the ritual's startin'.
Indeed.
Yes
Your dress is ridiculous.
You have a goat head.
Oh, way to go for the low-hanging fruit, Vindicta. Real classy!
Yes
So let me guess: you're gonna sit back and shoot at people while I run in and do all the real work?

Tell you what, Billy: when you can cleanly shoot someone running centre pack at the Boston Marathon from five blocks away, we can trade roles. In the meantime, shut up and swing your bat like a good little boy.
Yes
Don't think I've seen you since you got pinched.
It's cause you never bothered to visit. If I didn't know better, I'd think you stopped caring.
I just assumed you busted out!
You're looking good. New jacket?
You like it?
I'll like it even better on the ground of a dark alley.
Oh, I know where we're goin' after the ritual...
Y'mind if I call you Lash?
I don't give a shit.
You been stayin' out of trouble?
No, [sigh]. You?
Come on, V! I thought you knew me.
Hey, people change!
Nah... people don't change. They just stop pretendin' to be somethin' they're not.
Me 'n you are about to wreck some shop.
God, I'm so glad to be working with you and not some of these other stiffs.
Let's summon a god, V.
Yes
Oh, great. I'm with the paper gangster.
What did you call me?
Lady, you don't wanna be a crime lord, you wanna be a mayor. And while you're kissing babies, the Seventh Moon is gonna eat your lunch.
Oh, you're a fan of the Seventh Moon.
Easy, easy, I didn't say that!
That's what I thought.
Yes

Look, Billy: I know that people give you shit for having a goat head and I just wanted to say that I really appreciate that whatever bet you lost to have that be the case, you were man enough to follow through with the consequences.
You think I look like this cause I lost a bet?
If you didn't, you're even dumber than I thought.
Go to hell!
Yes
What do you do for fun?
What?
What do you do for fun? I mean, you say you hate everything, but there has to be somethin'.
Don't act like you wanna get to know me!
I do.
Bullshit.
I really do!
Why?
So we can find common ground. Share some laughs! Bet on sports games, then hold markers when you can't cover 'em- it's a whole thing, but it starts with building a connection, you know?
You are stupid, Billy.
Yeah? Well you're an asshole.
And yet, you are still stupid.
New York's not gonna kiss the ground you walk on, Yamato!
Not yet.
Not ever, lady!
Sigil Slam's ready.
Slam's almost ready!
Slam's on cooldown!
Ain't no problem a bat can't solve.
I'll cave in their skulls!
Can't wait to swing this baby.
Not many problems a bat can't solve.
Ready to play a pickup game with their heads?
I ain't a baseball guy so much as a bat guy.
Time to smash the machine.
Let's see 'em look at me sideways now.
They look at me funny? And I'm takin' skulls.
Ready to start a riot!
Batter up, baby!
Swingin’!
You ain’t stoppin’ me!
I gotcha.
You wanna play?
[Laughter]
Leave it to me.
You’re dead.
Crackin’em open!
You want a piece of me?
I'll go down swingin'.
I ain't givin' up.
You ain't winnin'!
I'll take you with me!
You wanna play?
Charge is ready!
Charge is almost ready!
Charge is on cooldown.
Don't gotta overthink it, just charge in!
I'll gore 'em.
I'll run 'em down!
First I knock 'em up, then I knock 'em down!
Almost time for the running of the goat!
I used to do this in circle pits before venues started being babies.
Goat horns get zero respect in this city, It's all Ixian this, ram horns that.
They better run if they know what's good for 'em.
And Ma said this head was good for nothin'.
It ain't why I turned my head into a goat... But it's a hell of a perk.
Ready to get blasted!
Blasted's almost ready.
Blasted's on cooldown.
Who's ready to party?
Ready to get this party started!
You got no idea how much beer I can fit in this jacket.
Drink for me, bat for them. It's a match made in heaven!
Smash the bottle, smash their heads, smash the ritual!
Open-container laws are bullshit.
Who's ready to throw down?!
I ain't runnin' from a fight!
Time to pick a fight.
I'm gonna tear it all down.
Party time!
Let’s party!
You want the horns? You got it.
It’s go time!
Let’s go!
Ready to rumble, baby!
This is how we get it done!
Go time!
I’m blasted, baby!
Wooh!
I ain't stopping.
They can't slow me down.
Just need a pick-me-up.
This'll work out fine.
Need a little liquid courage.
I can chain 'em!
Ready to chain 'em!
I'll tie 'em to me!
Ready to get in the mix!
Ready to start some shit.
Ready to go in.
Ready to take 'em all on.
Ready for a team fight.
Ready to get in there and get my hands dirty.
Ready to pick a fight.
Chain Gang's almost ready.
Chain Gang's on cooldown!
They ain't gonna get very far.
Let's chain 'em up!
When they think they're gettin' away, I'll pull 'em back in.
Ready to make some new friends and kill 'em!
I got enough chain for all of 'em.
If they wanna mess with the goat, they're gonna regret it.
I don't got time to be scared when I use this.
Pop this bad boy when I'm makin' my move.
Ready to go in there and give 'em hell!
Time to get a little nuts!
Chained ‘em!
Let’s dance!
The party’s here, pal.
I’ll grab ‘em!
Time to get up close and personal.
Don’t go runnin’ off on me!
Show me what you’ve got!
I don’t back down from a fight.
Kill me if you can!
Let’s see who’s still standin’.
You wanna go?
Where you think you're goin'?
I ain't finished with you!
This ends when I say it ends!
I'll take care of 'em.
They're done.
Kicked their ass!
You think you're better than me?!
You ain't nothin' to me.
This is my city!
Buddy, you never had a chance in hell.
Come back and I'll do it again, pal.
This ain't gonna be the last time I kick your ass.
They got nothin'!
And I thought the Knickerbockers sucked this year.
Sit your ass down!
You got nothin'!
What a joke!
No way I was gonna lose to you.
You asked for this fight, buddy.
You ain't on top now, are ya, pal?
I shut that asshole down!
They got what was comin' to 'em.
Way to not suck.
We got 'em!
They ain't puttin' up much of a fight.
They can't hold us down!
They got what they deserved.
Time to start a riot!
I'm taking their team apart, brick by brick!
Thought you guys were supposed to be hard?
You're gonna have to do a hell of a lot better than that if you wanna stop me!
They're gettin' the horns now, baby! Ha ha!
Don't worry, boys and girls! You're all gonna get a turn.
Y'all tryin' to silence me, but bad news: The truth doesn't make a noise, baby!
You want some more?!
There ain't none of yous who can stop me!
Let's see which one of you rich assholes has what it takes to stop me!
I ain't goin' anywhere, baby, I am New York!
Ice blast!
Cold Front!
Sendin' ice!
Colossus!
I'm about to smash in their skulls!
You wanna mess with me, buddy?
Curse!
I'll curse 'em.
They're about to be cursed!
Decay!
They ain't gonna be feeling good in a second.
This'll slow their healing.
Echo Shard!
Ready to do it again.
You want some more of that?
Metal skin!
Their bullets won't do shit.
I ain't gettin' shot!
Phantom Strike!
Teleportin' in!
Movin' in.
Refreshing!
Power's back.
Time to chain 'em up.
Shadow Weave.
They ain't seein' me.
How do you think I get away from the cops so much?
I'll silence 'em.
They won't be using their powers for much longer.
I'll shut down their magic.
I'm unstoppable, baby!
You think I give a shit about your magic?
Buddy, there ain't nothin' you can do to me.
Vampiric Burst!
Ready to go all out.
Time to tear 'em up!
Gotta train my powers.
Can't forget to upgrade my powers.
Ready to upgrade my abilities.
Time to do some shoppin'.
I gotta pick somethin' up.
I can get somethin' at the shop.
I can afford some better shit.
Wonder what the shopkeeper has for me now?
Time to pick up somethin' new at the store.
Finally. I can afford some of the good shit.
Buy the right item, and life will get a hell of a lot easier.
I need to swing by the Curiosity Shop when I get the chance.
I can afford the best, baby.
There's nothin' I can't buy!
No point on sittin' on the souls. I gotta spend this shit!
Nuh uh.
Nice try, buddy.
Ain't happenin'.
Get outta here with that weak shit.
You ain't doin' that.
That ain't gonna happen.
I don't think so.
Not your day, pal!
There's souls lyin' around!
I should check out those loose souls.
I can't believe those idiots are leaving souls around here!
The rich bastard'll never miss it.
People leavin' souls lying around like they're nothin'!
Can't believe someone could pass this up!
I ain't leavin' this lying around.
Yoink!
They can have the souls, the objective's what's important.
Took down another objective.
We're gonna finish this ritual if it kills me!
That ain't the last objective we're takin', baby!
The ritual's gettin' closer to being finished, baby!
Come out and play, pal!
Why you hidin' from me?
Oh, you wanna start shit but not finish it! I see how it is.
Almost had 'em.
Keep runnin', asshole!
I'm right here, pal.
Come on back, we were havin' fun!
What? You don't like playin' in the real world?
Shit, that was close.
They ain't messin' around.
They tried to kill me, but they can't, because they suck!
Jokes on you, pal! People been tryin' to kill me since I was in the womb!
I ain't gettin' killed by chumps like them!
Those assholes could be anywhere!
Course the team ain't with me... why would they be with me though, the lazy bastards...
Alright, Billy. The only guy you can count on is yourself.
Of course everyone else died and left me holdin' the bag!
God, do I have to do everything?!
"Oh, we'll let Billy handle it!" Bunch of assholes...
Oh, hell no!
There's too many of 'em!
I'm not likin' my chances.
Death ain't stoppin' us!
We got the Rejuvenator!
You know, this used to go to everybody 'til the man decided it was too good.
They got the Rejuvenator!
Great. They got the Rejuv.
They got the Rejuv. They'll be comin' for us soon.
Let's smash their Patron.
Time to finish things.
This show's gone on long enough.
I can't miss the end of this.
Can't let the team have all the fun.
Don't waste your bullets on 'em!
We can't shoot 'em!
They got metal skin!
I'm outta here.
I'll be back later! You're on your own.
You wanna stick around, that's your business.
I ain't feeling so good.
Do I get a thank you? Of course not.
We killed it!
Too easy!
Only way this was gonna end.
Hey, your taste in music? Sucks.

Those chumps think they can beat us?
They gonna wish they never stepped foot in New York.
So these are the guys that wanna try and keep us down, huh?
All of you are starin' at me, and I'm not havin' it!
Let's see what the Patron gave me to work with.
Hope you guys can keep up!
Do I get a thank you? Of course not.
Watch, the Patron ain't gonna fulfil their end of the bargain.
Maybe you guys don't suck after all.
We killed it!
Too easy!
Only way this was gonna end.
Help the big guy!
Help Abrams kick their ass!
We're going in, boys!
That's right, Abrams, keep fightin'!
You can't stop Abrams!
Glad the blue guy's on our side.
Not bad for a tin can.
Bebop's pullin' 'em in!
Bebop's got one!
You're my kind of asshole, Bebop.
Smart thinkin', Bebop!
That was petty, and I loved it.
They took out the test pilot!
Dynamo has 'em!
Help out Dynamo!
Black hole! black hole!
Looks like higher education is good for somethin' after all.
Thanks.
Thanks.
I'll pay you back, Profess- I just don't wanna owe you nothin'!
The old man ain't totally useless.
Okay, maybe you know how to use a bow.
I ain't making jokes about the bow no more.
Where the hell did that owl come from?
Grey Talon came through.
Thanks, Talon!
So that's where my tax dollars go.
Glad I pay her salary.
Tone it down around Haze... Got it.
Maybe government-killing machines aren't so bad.
Now I feel bad callin' her a stooge.
Haze saved my ass.
I'm using this, but I'm not happy about it.
I pay your salary, Holliday, I can use this!
Oh, God!
We gotta help Holliday!
Give Holliday a hand!
Holliday needs backup!
Nice job, Infernus!
Let's burn it down, baby!
That didn't last long!
Thanks, Ivy!
Maybe there's somethin' to workin' with you after all, Ivy.
Ivy, you're not as bad as I thought!
Kelvin really came through!
I needed that, Kelvin.
Thanks for the help, Kelvin.
Good God, Geist.
That was mean.
Don't piss off Geist. Got it.
Jesus, Lash!
Lash came from nowhere!
Lash just messed them up!
Good wall!
Thanks for setting that up, McG.
Smart thinking, McGinnis!
Great, now I owe Fairfax Industries.
Maybe McGinnis isn't as bad as I thought.
Thanks, McGinnis.
Help out the mole!
Krill has 'em.
Thanks, Krill!
Nyeheheheheheh.
Alright, that was kind of funny.
Dick move, Paradox.
Yeah, okay, maybe he's as dangerous as they say.
That was a massacre!
One guy did all that?!
